data.description:
Translate legacy query patterns to expr syntax for backwards compatibility.

Pattern mappings:
- 'blocked tasks' → 'status = blocked' OR blocked()
- 'what blocks T-123' → parents('T-123')
- 'tasks in sprint S-001' → in_sprint('S-001')
- 'orphan tasks' → orphan_nodes()
- etc. (21 patterns total)

Implementation options:
A. Simple regex-based translator
B. Small grammar/parser for natural language
C. Dict-based pattern → expr mapping

Files to create:
- cortical/got/expression/natural_language.py

Depends on: Function calls work in expr
data.title: Create natural language to expr translator
